title: First Class Artifact Examples
description: Examples must be first-class citizens. Every artifact (on subset level) registers examples. There should automatically be a dropdown for every editor such as in semio-tech play or the mit-bestand demonstrator. The dropdown must not be missing (for example https://play.semio-tech.com/#lowpoly must show it) and must not be inert: clicking it opens the list of all registered examples for that artifact subset, and clicking an example switches the editor to that example.
